Body.Content:
SQL Server 2025, the AI-ready enterprise database, is now generally available, marking a major milestone in Microsoft’s mission to modernize enterprise data platforms. This release introduces built-in AI capabilities, seamless integration with Microsoft Fabric and Azure, and enhanced developer productivity through familiar T-SQL extensions. Now you can boost performance and security using intelligent query processing, optimized concurrency, and Microsoft Entra-based identity management. 

 

SQL Server 2025 is designed for hybrid environments—on-premises, multi-cloud, and edge—delivering enterprise-grade reliability and compliance while enabling next-generation AI scenarios. 

Learn more.
